title: UniverseMeta
description: Metadata for a story universe. Each universe may contain multiple book projects.

canon_status.description: Overall canon posture for this universe.

cosmology_id.description: Optional reference to a cosmology_meta.json at data/cosmologies/<cosmology_id>/. When set, this universe belongs to a meta-universe that it shares with other franchises (Sanderson-style shared cosmology). Consumed lazily — engine behaviour with this field set is identical to without until a later phase wires cross-universe lore resolution.

branch_point.description: Optional AU divergence metadata. When set, declares how this universe diverges from a source canon. Consumed by canon_expert in Phase 6; in Phase 2 this is descriptive only.

source_canon.description: Name of the canon this universe diverges from (e.g., 'Star Wars Legends EU', 'Tolkien Middle-earth').

divergence_point.description: When/where the divergence occurs (e.g., 'post-Lost Tribe crisis, circa 44 ABY').

divergence_description.description: Narrative description of how this universe differs from source canon from the divergence point forward.

commercial_intent.description: How the generated prose is intended to be used. Schema-level tag in Phase 2; guardrails tied to this value (canon_expert strictness, entity-remap validators, export-manifest license blocks) are wired in later phases.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the universe context.
